items.title: Social Media Manager
items.summary: Own LARIAL LTD's social presence end-to-end — build a content engine that turns CAC compliance into clear, useful, on-brand storytelling for Nigerians at home and abroad.
responsibilities: Plan and publish a weekly content calendar across Instagram, X, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, and WhatsApp Status
Write short-form copy, captions, and hooks that explain CAC services in plain language
Produce or commission lightweight graphics, reels, and short-form video (Canva / CapCut level)
Run community management — DMs, comments, replies — and route serious leads to WhatsApp
Track engagement and follower growth; report what's working and iterate monthly
Coordinate with Ops/Compliance to turn real client wins into shareable case studies
requirements: 1+ year managing brand social accounts (agency or in-house)
Strong written communication in English; Pidgin a plus
Comfortable with Canva, CapCut, and at least one scheduling tool (Meta Business Suite, Buffer, or similar)
Eye for clean, modern, on-brand visuals
Self-starter who can ship without micromanagement
Bonus: familiarity with CAC / SME / fintech audiences in Nigeria

items.title: Software Marketing Executive
items.summary: Results-driven Software Marketing Executive with experience promoting software products and technology solutions through targeted campaigns, client engagement, and market research. Skilled in lead generation, product demonstrations, CRM management, digital marketing, and building long-term customer relationships. Adept at coll
responsibilities: Promote and market software products and solutions to prospective and existing clients.
Identify potential customers, generate leads, and develop new business opportunities.
Conduct product demonstrations and explain software features, benefits, and pricing.
Prepare and deliver marketing materials, presentations, proposals, and quotations.
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, partners, and stakeholders.
Follow up on leads, inquiries, and sales opportunities to convert them into customers.
Develop and execute marketing campaigns across email, social media, events, and digital channels.
Maintain accurate records of leads, customer interactions, and sales activities in the CRM.
Attend meetings, exhibitions, conferences, and networking events to represent the company.
Provide customer feedback to improve products, services, and marketing strategies.
requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field.
Proven experience in software marketing, sales, business development, or a related role.
Strong understanding of software products, technology solutions, and the sales cycle.
Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Ability to conduct product demonstrations and explain technical concepts in simple terms.
Experience with CRM software and lead-management tools.
Knowledge of digital marketing channels, including email, social media, SEO, and online advertising.
Ability to build relationships with clients, partners, and internal teams.
Self-motivated, target-driven, and able to work independently or as part of a team.
Willingness to travel for client meetings, events, exhibitions, and business development activities.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, presentation tools, and marketing software.
